outlook.statement: Singular and absolute priority is comprehensive revival of overall situation through multi-track recovery strategy: legal track (resolving property, lease, regulatory compliance hurdles including Mahim lease dispute execution orders) and operational track (optimizing technology products, expanding application features, scaling digital healthcare revenues to rebuild institutional strength and build sustainable capital reserves).

The ongoing corporate focus is dedicated to optimizing remaining cost structures, enhancing capital efficiency, and scaling digital application revenues to balance long-term financial performance until a suitable alternative brick-and-mortar premise can be established.

The primary and immediate focus of management is the comprehensive revival of the overall situation through a dual recovery map: resolving ongoing legal and regulatory hurdles through appropriate legal channels, and systematically commercializing technology products, attracting new digital consumers, and building up sustainable capital reserves to restore systemic stability and enhance stakeholder value over the coming cycles.
